policy.subtitle: What cookies we use, why, and how you can control them at any time.

what.title: What is a cookie?
what.text: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device when you visit a website. Similar technologies, such as the browser’s local storage, work the same way. They allow a site to remember information about your visit.

how.title: How we use them
how.text: NovaBridge only uses the cookies strictly necessary for the site to work without your consent. All other categories are disabled by default and only activated if you accept them. The list below is always up to date with the cookies actually used on this site.

browser.title: Managing cookies in your browser
browser.text: You can also block or delete cookies from your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies may prevent some features, such as the quote form, from working properly.

more.title: Still have a question?
more.text: Our multilingual team answers in English, French and Chinese — usually within 24 hours.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Fill in our free quote form or e-mail us with the product, quantity and specifications you need (sizes, colors, branding). You receive a detailed quote with pricing and a production timeline within 24 hours.

items.q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
items.a: Our minimum order starts from 50–100 units depending on the product — including custom-branded items. Tell us your quantity and we will find the right option.

items.q: Can you put our logo on the products?
items.a: Yes. Custom branding is available on all our product lines: your logo, your colors, your sizes. Private label and OEM manufacturing are also available, and we can provide a free 3D mock-up before production.
Production takes 3 to 4 weeks on average. Delivery time then depends on the shipping method: sea freight (standard, DDP) or DHL / FedEx Express for urgent orders.
DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) means customs duties and freight are included in our price. Your goods are delivered to your door with no surprise at customs.
Once you confirm the order, you pay a 50% deposit to launch production at the factory. The balance is paid at delivery.

We work with selected factories in China’s top production hubs and check every batch. You receive quality-control photos before every shipment, so you approve your goods before they leave the factory.

items.q: Which countries do you deliver to?
items.a: We deliver businesses across the USA, Canada, Europe and Africa. For African clients we route sea freight through the port of Durban; urgent orders can travel by DHL or FedEx Express.

Entertainment merchandise (grip socks, wristbands, cups, balloons…), Pilates studio essentials (grip socks, mats, towels…), PPE & safety equipment, healthcare supplies, apparel & uniforms, and corporate perks & promotional products. Looking for something not listed? Ask us — we source directly from Shenzhen, Yiwu, Jiangsu and Zhuji.

items.q: Which languages does your team speak?
items.a: Our team works in English, French and Chinese, which lets us communicate directly with both our clients and the factories.
